create_evaluator: create an Evaluator instance with custom config to evaluate tracking metrics on datasets
run_evaluator_evaluate: run the Evaluator.evaluate method to evaluate multiple trackers on multiple datasets using specified metrics
get_default_eval_config: get the default Evaluator config dict with parallelism, error handling, and output options
eval_single_sequence: evaluate a single tracking sequence using eval_sequence with dataset, tracker, and metrics
combine_evaluation_results: combine per-sequence evaluation results into class-averaged, detection-averaged, and super-class summaries
